items.title: Abby “Chinee Bébé” Foster Interview, 1961-03-09
items.q: I tried to learn Alec Begaard that, but he never could learn it.

ctx.x: The make is HDC, I don't know, I think that's the Hall Drum Company. You know, the Hall Drum Company down here on Decatur Street. Decatur Street. They look like a...

Well, none of the drummers, those drummers never show you that. I tried to learn Alec Begaard that, but he never could learn it. I never saw anybody do that. Well, you know, in fact, to tell you the truth, Alec Begaard, our uncle was a great violin player too.
